errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays a series of labels representing different model configurations and datasets
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is not labeled; the labels for the different models are in the legend, corresponding to the colored bars.
The model name in the legend is "ExEnt", not "ExExt".

errors.text_span: with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 65%
errors.evidence: The y-axis does not start at 0%; its visible range is from just below 40% to 65%.
The description omits the other visible y-axis tick labels at 40%, 50%, and 65%.

errors.text_span: The bars are sorted from left to right in ascending order of accuracy.
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in ascending order. For example, the second bar (55%) is taller than the third and fourth bars (both approx. 47%).
The bar for "RoBERTa w/o Exp" is light gray, not white.
The value for "RoBERTa w/o Exp" is approximately 46%, not 48%.
The "ExEnt" bar is exactly on the 55% gridline, not 54%.
The value for "LaSQuE (mean)" is approximately 47%, which is well above the 45% line. 43% is a significant error.
The value for "LaSQuE" is approximately 47%, not 52%.
The value for "LaSQuE (syn2real)" is clearly above 55%, at approximately 58.5%. 53% is a significant error.
